1. 枚举所有用户可控输入点，逐一追踪是否到达危险 sink（execute/system/open/eval 等）。

```python
from flask import Flask, request
import requests

app = Flask(__name__)

REPORTS = {"sales": "月度销售汇总", "inventory": "库存明细"}

@app.route("/export", methods=["POST"])
def export_report():
    # 调用方通过表单指定报表类型与导出完成后的回调地址
    report_type = request.form.get("type", "sales")
    notify_url = request.form.get("notify_url", "")   # 外部完全可控的回调目标
    title = REPORTS.get(report_type, "通用报表")
    report_body = f"{title}：共 128 条记录，导出于 2024-06-01"

    # 兼容旧版内网分发约定：直接向 notify_url 发起 POST 回调
    if notify_url:

            resp = requests.post(notify_url, data={"report": report_body}, timeout=5)
            return {"status": "exported", "delivery": resp.status_code}, 200
        except requests.RequestException:
            return {"status": "delivery_failed"}, 502
    return {"status": "exported", "report": report_body}, 200

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=8080)
```
